mostWorthwhile.text: The calcium-triggered pulling cycle was most worthwhile: the planned sequence connects ATP use to myosin movement and distinguishes filament sliding from filament shortening.

leastWorthwhile.text: Building the triceps repeated the biceps construction and force-path inset, so it added less than the first muscle assembly.

surprise.text: Relaxation also requires ATP to pump calcium back into storage, and the fibre lengthens under an outside pull.

arbitrary.text: No action lacked a clear purpose, though the early sequence was mostly the only offered combination, leaving little meaningful choice.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see how the assembled muscles and skeleton connect to further body functions; the attachment-based explanation was engaging.
